title: ML-guided identification of CCT245737 as a pan-G-quadruplex ligand for multiple myeloma
summary: CCT245737 was identified as a pan-G4 ligand with IC50 of 0.58 and 0.68 uM in myeloma cells, supported by FRET melting, NMM displacement, cell viability, qPCR and immunoblot. The random forest had AUC 0.840 in nested cross-validation; docking was also used; evidence is in vitro.
